mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) indicates a flattening yield curve, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate signals a break above the Fed's 2% target, prompting preemptive rate hikes that reduce equity discount rates and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in inflation surprise periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS employment growth suggests a strengthening labor market, which reduces recession risk and increases investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strong labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO supply growth indicates a contraction in domestic production capacity, which raises scarcity premiums and compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in supply contraction periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly FEDFUNDS rates indicates a disinflationary bias, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in softening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
